name: Brenda O.
title: Having everyone under one roof made our weekend.
text: We booked the whole 8-bedroom compound for my parents' anniversary so the family wouldn't be split across different hotels in town. Sitting out in the garden together at dusk while my sisters made tea in the kitchen was the highlight of the trip. At 15k a night with secure parking for four cars, it felt like an absolute steal.

name: Wanjiru & Mark
title: Phillip saved us after a delayed flight!
text: We landed in Kisumu late with two exhausted toddlers and got a little turned around in the dark, so Phillip stayed on WhatsApp guiding our driver right to the gate. Walking into a spotless suite with fresh sheets and a kitchen where I could immediately warm milk for the kids felt like arriving at a relative’s home.

name: David Otieno
title: The best base in Kisumu for a big group.
text: Twelve of us came down for my brother’s traditional ceremony and took the full compound. Having proper kitchens meant we could cook breakfast together every morning, and having the whole place to ourselves meant we could catch up late into the night without worrying about disturbing hotel neighbours.

name: Sharon A.
title: Pictures don’t even do the lighting justice.
text: Usually Airbnb photos look way better than reality, but Lattafa is the exact opposite—the rooms feel so fresh, bright, and spacious. My partner and I stayed three nights in the 1-bedroom suite and barely wanted to leave the house.

name: Tasha N.
title: Slow mornings done right.
text: Four couples, one long weekend, zero stress. It’s a quick drive into town for fish by the lake, but coming back to a quiet, gated compound at night felt so good. Huge shoutout to Phillip and the team for being so warm and easy to deal with.
